description: TextbookSimulations is an educational resource listed in best-of-ps, a ranked list of open-source power-system-analysis projects under the section "educational resource", published or maintained by Power-Systems-Textbook (repository owner; maintainers as on the project page). Examples and problems accompanying Daniel Kirschen's Power Systems Textbook. Coverage: not geographically bound. The list files it under "educational resource". Implementation language: Julia. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC0-1.0 (as given in the list). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support teaching and learning power-system analysis. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-best-of-ps.
